items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Booker, Larry Willis, and Jimmy Cobb, swingin’ record.

ctx.x: A couple of dates for our friend Steve Satten for Contempo Vibrato, one with Jimmy Cobb, one under your name called Lieb Up Close.
Yep. Booker, Larry Willis, and Jimmy Cobb, swingin’ record. And Steve. Steve is on a couple tracks.
Here’s a big date with Moses: Visit with the Great Spirit, for Gramavision.
